notes: The law prints no financing column for any programme or account: external resources appear only as national totals (investment on external resources, 248,000,000,000 of 461,000,000,000 in the equilibrium table; project loans and grants by economic title). The table misprints that second line as internal resources; the 2024 settlement law repeats the split, again only in aggregate.
